About us

Property Media Japan specialises in Real Estate Photography, Videography, Aerial Photography, Floor-plans and Virtual Staging. Previously based in Queenstown New Zealand, we are now operating in Niseko, Hokkaido Japan.

seoData.seoDescription: Newly built 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom townhouse in Niseko, Japan, featuring mountain views, open-plan living, a private garden patio, and a high-end kitchen. It is perfect for anyone seeking luxury in Japan’s top winter destination. Rely on Property Media for expert real estate photography, videography, floor plans, virtual staging, and drone photography to showcase properties like this.
